edition.locus: Baehrens GCS 33 Comm. Cant. Liber II 7

source_text: Botrus cypri dilectus meus mihi in vineis Engaddi. Cyprus flos et odor et medicina; Engaddi locus unguentorum. Christus et odor vitae et medicina vulnerum et botrus vini novi. In vineis Engaddi: in ecclesiis ubi unguenta Spiritus conficiuntur.
pass_a_gloss: Cluster of-henna beloved my to-me in vineyards of-Engedi. Henna flower and fragrance and medicine; Engedi place of-ointments...
pass_b_english: [[A cluster of henna is my beloved to me in the vineyards of Engedi >> Bible:Song of Songs 1:14]]. Henna is flower and fragrance and medicine; Engedi a place of ointments. Christ is both the fragrance of life and the medicine of wounds and the cluster of new wine. In the vineyards of Engedi: in the churches where the Spirit’s ointments are compounded.
